scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @manifold-studio/wrapper && npm run build --workspace @manifold-studio/typeface && npm run build --workspace @manifold-studio/configurator && npm run build --workspace @manifold-studio/create-app
scripts.build:dev-deps: npm run build --workspace @manifold-studio/wrapper && npm run build --workspace @manifold-studio/typeface && npm run build --workspace @manifold-studio/configurator
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/check-build-before-test.js && node scripts/check-port-before-integration.js && npx vitest run tests/integration/
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @manifold-studio/wrapper & npm run dev:configurator
scripts.devAll: REPO_HMR=true npm run dev --workspace @manifold-studio/wrapper & REPO_HMR=true npm run dev:configurator
scripts.dev:reference: npm run build:dev-deps && cd reference-project && node ../packages/configurator/dist/cli/index.js dev
scripts.prepare: npm run build -w packages/wrapper && npm run build -w packages/configurator
